description: This file defines a class 'AnyOf' within the hierarchy of validation rule composites, extending an abstract composite class. It specifies a method to return the class name of a validation rule from the Respect Validation library, indicating its purpose for composite validation logic in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: AnyOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that extends an abstract composite, representing a logical OR of multiple validation rules.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the specific validation rule from the Respect Validation library that this composite class wraps.
